🚨 **BREAKING**: Elon Musk is planning an unprecedented move for retail investors in the SpaceX IPO!

He’s considering allocating **up to 30%** of SpaceX’s IPO to retail investors — triple the typical 5-10% — per Reuters.

The goal? To tap his loyal fans in what could be a **$1.75 trillion** valuation IPO.

Elon is taking a hands-on approach with banks, assigning them specific roles instead of broad competition. Bank of America is expected to lead U.S. retail distribution, alongside Morgan Stanley and UBS.

The biggest IPO in history is prioritizing retail! 🚀
